test_ssh_bulk_upload_empty_files: test _ssh_bulk_upload returns early without spawning subprocesses when given an empty file list
test_ssh_bulk_upload_mkdir_batched: test _ssh_bulk_upload batches all parent directory creation into a single SSH mkdir -p call
test_ssh_bulk_upload_tar_pipe: test _ssh_bulk_upload wires tar create and SSH extract processes into a streaming pipe
test_ssh_bulk_upload_staging_symlinks: test _ssh_bulk_upload creates staging symlinks that mirror the remote directory layout
test_quoted_mkdir_command: test quoted_mkdir_command generates a valid mkdir -p shell command with proper quoting for special characters
